name: Stars Arena
rootCause: The Stars Arena smart contract on Avalanche C-Chain contained a reentrancy vulnerability in its share-pricing and selling logic. The sellShares function performed an external AVAX transfer to the caller before updating internal state, allowing the attacker to re-enter a separate function during that callback to manipulate the block-height variable used to calculate the AVAX payout. By setting this parameter to an artificially high value before the share price was finalized, the attacker inflated the value of a single share to approximately 274,000 AVAX (~$274K). With just 1 AVAX deposited, the attacker drained 266,103 AVAX (~$2.9M) from the contract, leaving it with only $0.05 in TVL. The contract was reportedly unaudited and did not follow the Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern or employ a reentrancy guard. Attack Tx: 0x49c5b3b414bf874689de9a5b98c55445659c2fd2ad6f8a3cdd4e0203937c395e Analysis: Stars Arena Hack — Oct 7, 2023 — Detailed Analysis (ImmuneBytes)
